claim: The demo uses isolated sample data, saves no connection, and resets in one click.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; mutate and reset; inspect network and connection storage

claim: The console has no paid tier, payment step, or payment request.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load the landing page and sample workspace, use the product, and inspect controls, visible copy, and every request

claim: Creates and safely deletes buckets in the sample workspace.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; create a bucket; delete it through the version-aware danger flow

claim: Browses prefix folders and filters object names.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 seeded media archive; navigate two prefixes and filter results

claim: Uploads a file to the selected bucket.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; upload known bytes and assert the object appears

claim: Downloads the original bytes of an object.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; download a seeded text object and assert its contents

claim: Deletes an object after confirmation.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; confirm deletion and assert the object disappears

claim: Copies an object with its metadata and tags.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; copy a seeded object to another sample bucket and inspect the destination

claim: Moves an object only after its destination copy succeeds.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; assert a successful move and assert a failed destination copy leaves its source intact

claim: Edits and reloads object metadata.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; edit metadata, reopen the object, and assert saved pairs

claim: Edits and reloads object tags.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; edit tags, reopen the object, and assert saved pairs

claim: Edits and reloads bucket policy JSON.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; replace policy JSON and reopen its settings tab

claim: Edits and reloads bucket browser-access rules.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; replace CORS JSON and reopen its settings tab

claim: Edits and reloads bucket lifecycle rules.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; replace lifecycle JSON and reopen its settings tab

claim: Enables or suspends bucket versioning and reloads both states.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; save Enabled and Suspended states, reopening settings after each save

claim: Creates an expiring signed download link.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; generate a GET link and assert method and 900-second expiry

claim: Creates an expiring signed upload link.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; generate a PUT link and assert method and 900-second expiry

claim: The console makes no analytics or tracking requests and sets no cookies; the demo writes no normal storage keys.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; navigate, mutate, reset, and exit; inspect requests, cookies, and every local- and session-storage key

claim: The offline cache contains only public same-origin console files, never object-store responses, object names, or credentials.
sandbox: fresh browser; connect to a mocked object store, browse an object, then inspect every Cache Storage request URL and body

claim: Real connection details stay in session storage unless remember is selected.
sandbox: mock chosen endpoint; connect once without remember and once with it; inspect both browser stores after each flow

claim: Disconnecting removes saved connection details from both browser stores.
sandbox: seed both stores; restore a mocked endpoint; disconnect and assert both keys are gone

claim: Signed storage requests go only to the chosen endpoint and never contain the secret key.
where: landing connection card, privacy page, README
sandbox: mock a configured endpoint; capture URL and headers; assert destination, access ID, and secret absence

claim: The sample workspace reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser; visit /?demo=1; await service worker; go offline and reload

claim: The selected color theme persists in normal mode.
sandbox: fresh normal-mode browser context; toggle theme and reload

claim: The console does not manage users, replication, monitoring, or provider-specific settings.
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1; assert no controls expose excluded administration areas

claim: The console identifies blocked mixed-content endpoints and explains browser-access network failures.
sandbox: unit sandbox; check HTTPS-to-HTTP validation and a rejected fetch error

claim: Uploads files larger than 8 MiB with the S3 multipart protocol.
sandbox: fresh browser connection to a disposable S3 protocol harness; upload 8 MiB plus one byte and assert initiate, parts, completion, bytes, and exposed ETag headers

claim: The starter browser-access rule allows every HTTP method the console sends.
sandbox: fresh browser at /; cross-origin disposable CORS server; assert the published exact method set and a successful preflight plus request for each method

claim: Path-style URLs are selected by default.
sandbox: fresh browser connection to a disposable S3 protocol harness; assert default control and bucket request path

claim: Bucket-subdomain URLs place the bucket in the request hostname and keep object keys in the path.
where: connection URL format selector, landing DNS/certificate help, README configuration
sandbox: fresh browser; select Bucket subdomain URLs, connect to a mocked endpoint, browse an object, and assert signed hostname and path

claim: The source is linked and the repository uses the MIT License.
sandbox: repository checkout; inspect LICENSE and the published source link

claim: The generated artwork source and disclosure are recorded.
sandbox: repository checkout; inspect original asset, design provenance, and footer disclosure

claim: The production build writes a static site to dist.
sandbox: clean checkout after npm ci; run production build and inspect dist entry and deployment config

claim: The repository configures Azure Static Web Apps routing, security headers, and cache rules.
sandbox: repository checkout; assert SPA fallback, HTTP 404 override, security headers, shell revalidation, and immutable asset caching
